The Ink Gallery
I was asked to investigate The Blood Pages of Bhaal, held in the basement of the Ink Gallery in Athkatla. I've accepted the job. Let's see if it's truly as impressive as it seems.

The Ink Gallery
The Ink Gallery is a place filled with powerful books. I was allowed to learn from them; face all the struggles that were immortalized on their pages. One of them was a tome called The Blood Pages of Bhaal. It showed me scenes and characters from my own story. It was a truly bizarre mission, but I managed to finish the job.
